about_short_description.short_description: Double's objective is to create software that helps accountants generate higher-quality work faster and with fewer errors.

product.name: Keeper Bookkeeping Practice Management Software
product.description: A software platform integrating with QuickBooks and Xero to manage bookkeeping workflows, client communication, and month-end close processes.

product.name: Client Portal
product.description: A custom-branded, secure portal for clients to communicate, upload documents, and respond to transaction questions linked to their ledger.

product.name: File Reviews
product.description: Automated review tools that detect and correct common bookkeeping errors and standardize review processes across firms.

product.name: 1099 Management
product.description: A system to track vendors, request W-9 forms, and export 1099 data for tax filing purposes.

product.name: Custom Management Reports
product.description: A reporting tool that creates tailored financial reports with executive summaries, KPIs, and visuals, published directly to clients.

product.name: Task Management
product.description: A workflow tool to create, assign, and track recurring or one-off tasks across teams and clients within a firm-wide view.
